name: penwright
description: Typst document editor — let Claude Desktop drive your Penwright projects.
long_description: Penwright is a project-first WYSIWYG editor for Typst documents. This extension exposes 52 typed tools that let Claude open and edit your projects, manage chapters and bibliography, drive the structured design surface (themes / palettes / layouts / 19 design elements / per-chapter running heads), search across files, save versions, and export to PDF / DOCX. All Typst compilation runs through the bundled Typst binary, packages, and OFL fonts — no external dependencies, fully offline.

license_key.title: Penwright License Key
license_key.description: Your Penwright license key (starts with pw_LIC_). Required — the MCP server refuses to start without it. Get one at https://penwright.online.

tools.name: penwright_set_project
tools.description: Sets the active project directory. Call this first to tell Penwright which Typst project to work with.

tools.name: penwright_list_files
tools.description: Returns the project file tree (.typ, .bib, .md, .yaml, .json, .pdf, images).

tools.name: penwright_read_file
tools.description: Reads a file in the project; text content as string, binary as base64.

tools.name: penwright_write_file
tools.description: Writes content to a file in the project; creates parent folders automatically.

tools.name: penwright_create_project
tools.description: Creates a new Typst project from a template (document, thesis, paper, letter, book, magazine). The 'magazine' template is the Slow-Media editorial layout used by ai-magazine-designer.

tools.name: penwright_get_document
tools.description: Returns the current document (content, path, project dir, word count).

tools.name: penwright_open_file
tools.description: Opens a .typ file as the current document.

tools.name: penwright_update_document
tools.description: Replaces the current document content and saves to disk.

tools.name: penwright_compile
tools.description: Verifies the document compiles cleanly (PDF-only, artefact removed afterwards). Use export_pdf / export_docx for real output.

tools.name: penwright_get_settings
tools.description: Reads the document settings (language + bibliography style).

tools.name: penwright_update_settings
tools.description: Updates document settings; only passed keys are modified.

tools.name: penwright_get_style
tools.description: Returns the full ProjectStyle JSON (colors / fonts / scale / layout / headings / elements / custom).

tools.name: penwright_update_style
tools.description: Partial deep-merge patch with per-leaf sanitiser; invalid values fall back.

tools.name: penwright_list_styles
tools.description: Lists the six built-in themes (Classic Academic, Modern Tech, Editorial Magazine, Minimal, Marketing Brochure, Thesis).

tools.name: penwright_apply_style
tools.description: Applies a theme; overwrites colors/fonts/scale/layout/headings/elements, preserves custom.preamble.

tools.name: penwright_list_layouts
tools.description: Returns the seven layout presets (A4 portrait/landscape, Magazine 2-col, Newsletter 3-col, A5 Booklet, A2 Poster, Magazine Editorial).

tools.name: penwright_apply_layout
tools.description: Swaps only the layout.* values (and optionally scale.base); theme + colours + fonts unchanged.

tools.name: penwright_list_fonts
tools.description: Returns the seven bundled OFL fonts (Inter, IBM Plex Sans/Serif/Mono, JetBrains Mono, Crimson Pro, Spectral).

tools.name: penwright_apply_palette
tools.description: Sets the 5-colour palette via presetId or per-slot hex overrides.

tools.name: penwright_list_design_elements
tools.description: Library of 19 parametric design-element snippets (Banner / Sidebar / Pull-Quote variants / Callout / Hero / Divider variants / Drop-Cap / Article-Opener / Section-Opener / Gallery 2up+3up+asymmetric / Image-Overlay / Stats-Box / Photo-Caption-Wrap / Magazine-Cover).

tools.name: penwright_insert_design_element
tools.description: Inserts a design element at an anchor; snippets reference style-colors.* / style-fonts.* so they re-theme automatically.

tools.name: penwright_generate_layout
tools.description: High-level NL composite: intent ("brochure" / "magazine" / "thesis" / etc.) → theme + layout + optional hero.

tools.name: penwright_get_selection
tools.description: Returns the passage the user pinned via 'Design with AI' plus a design snapshot (theme / palette / fonts / layout / sectionStyle / usedElements); use anchorText + occurrence to design that exact spot.

tools.name: penwright_get_chapters
tools.description: Returns the #include structure (order, paths, file-exists flag).

tools.name: penwright_reorder_chapters
tools.description: Reorders the #include statements in the root document.

tools.name: penwright_add_chapter
tools.description: Creates a new chapter file in chapters/ and adds an #include.

tools.name: penwright_remove_chapter
tools.description: Removes an #include entry from the root document; the file itself is kept.

tools.name: penwright_merge_document
tools.description: Resolves all #include statements recursively and returns the merged document as a string.

tools.name: penwright_split_document
tools.description: Splits the current document at = heading-1 boundaries into individual chapter files.

tools.name: penwright_get_citations
tools.description: Returns all BibTeX entries from the project's .bib files.

tools.name: penwright_add_citation
tools.description: Adds a BibTeX entry to references.bib; creates the file and #bibliography statement if missing.

tools.name: penwright_ensure_bibliography
tools.description: Ensures the project has a references.bib and a #bibliography statement.

tools.name: penwright_list_labels
tools.description: Returns all <label> definitions with type classification and caption preview.

tools.name: penwright_insert_reference
tools.description: Inserts a Typst cross-reference (@label) at an anchor; validates the label exists.

tools.name: penwright_add_footnote
tools.description: Inserts a Typst footnote (#footnote[…]) at an anchor; bracket-balance check on the body.

tools.name: penwright_list_comments
tools.description: Lists Penwright comments (or just those of one file); never compiled.

tools.name: penwright_add_comment
tools.description: Creates a comment anchored to a verbatim text snippet; generates id, frontmatter, offset hints.

tools.name: penwright_resolve_comment
tools.description: Marks a comment as resolved (or un-resolves it).

tools.name: penwright_delete_comment
tools.description: Permanently deletes a comment (removes the .md file).

tools.name: penwright_save_version
tools.description: Saves a named version (Git commit); auto-initialises the repo if missing; local-only.

tools.name: penwright_list_versions
tools.description: Returns the version history (max 200, newest first) including an isAuto flag.

tools.name: penwright_show_version
tools.description: Returns the per-file diff for one version.

tools.name: penwright_restore_version
tools.description: Restores files from a historical version into the working tree.

tools.name: penwright_search_project
tools.description: Searches across all .typ (optionally .bib) files; whole-word lookarounds work for @citekey backlinks.

tools.name: penwright_replace_in_project
tools.description: Replaces all matches of a query project-wide; destructive — call save_version first.

tools.name: penwright_find_source_for_citation
tools.description: Looks up a PDF in sources/ matching a citekey.

tools.name: penwright_export_pdf
tools.description: Compiles and exports as PDF; output path must lie inside the project.

tools.name: penwright_export_docx
tools.description: Exports as DOCX with real Word styles and live multilevel numbering.

tools.name: penwright_import_markdown
tools.description: Converts Markdown to Typst and writes into a project file.

tools.name: penwright_add_image
tools.description: Imports an image into assets/ with content-hash dedup; builds a #figure snippet and optionally inserts it at an anchor.

tools.name: penwright_git_status
tools.description: Returns branch, ahead/behind, and changed files.

tools.name: penwright_git_commit
tools.description: Stages all changes and commits with the given message.

tools.name: penwright_git_push
tools.description: Pushes commits to the remote repository.
